objective: Reconstruct small explicit Lean consequences and audit the provenance of an analytic proof source.
context: The registered exercises are proxies with explicit hypotheses. The upstream source is linked and pinned without reproduction; module imports differ from minimal theorem dependencies.

steps.name: Pin upstream declarations
steps.description: Record declaration names and source identity.

steps.name: State the proxy theorem
steps.description: Specify quantifiers and premises separately from the original theorem.

steps.name: Audit dependencies
steps.description: Explain the limits of a module-import traversal.

steps.name: Construct proof
steps.description: Provide a type-correct candidate for a stated finite proxy.

steps.name: Kernel grade
steps.description: Reject unsafe/admitted terms and distinguish compiler success from wider mathematical claims.

specific_questions.prompt: Construct a self-contained elementary proxy implication and distinguish its proof from a proof of the original analytic conjecture.
Give an example in which a module import is unnecessary to a particular theorem, and describe a declaration-level dependency audit.
Explain how source pins and a kernel/axiom audit address different risks.

native_verifier: EvalMath spiral_ln.rh_distillation grader and independent Lean kernel.
